== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Grand [[Hive]] is a massive, planet-sized structure that serves as the fortress for the last [[Iron King]], who matured over four centuries ago. Visually, it resembles a colossal skull composed of black [[Iron|iron]] and smooth, white skin, featuring miles-long spikes that protrude from its main hangar bay. It is a formidable entity within the [[Iron Legion]], capable of deploying thousands of craft and acting as a significant threat to galactic security. The structure is characterized by its immense scale, appearing as large as a moon or planet to observers, and possesses defensive shields more powerful than those of standard fortress-worlds. Within its structure, it contains vast machinery and [[steel]] walkways, though it has been noted to be hollow after certain internal components were removed. The Grand [[Hive]] is also governed by a [[Bishop of the Iron Legion|Bishop]], an awakened consciousness that controls the hive for specific purposes. Despite its strength, the Grand [[Hive]] was famously devastated when a single ship utilized an [[Aethertech weapon]] to tear the structure in half.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Grand [[Hive]] is a moon-sized fortress that served as the stronghold for the final [[Iron King]] to mature over four centuries ago. Having previously survived an attack and serving as the site where both [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] and the protagonist once died, the massive structure was eventually struck by an astral tide. During a confrontation, the [[Fallen Sword]] utilized its [[Aethertech weapon]] to destroy the location's shields, causing ships to burst from every opening as the structure was broken into debris. The resulting wreckage remains visible outside the viewport, consisting of various chunks that can be tied together for scanning.}}
